name: Wicked
overview: Scripture reveals the wicked as those whose hearts are continually evil, as seen in the great wickedness of mankind before the Flood when God declared His Spirit would not strive with man forever. The men of Sodom exemplify extreme sinfulness, provoking God’s righteous judgment due to their grievous iniquities. The defilement of the land and its inhabitants, as described in Leviticus, underscores the serious consequences of persistent wickedness. These passages emphasize God's holiness and justice in response to human sinfulness, highlighting the urgent need for repentance.
